propositions: A closed child with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a live replacement link is exempted from completion verification in the close path but incorrectly required to carry a completion-verifier attestation in the certification path
child_closure_findings withholds parent certification when a disposition-closed child carries no completion-verifier attestation, though that child never needed to produce one
the close path and certification path encode conflicting rules for disposition classes, creating an unresolvable state with no honest non-force remedy
a disposition-closed child should resolve certification through its replacement link when a live replacement exists, rather than demanding an unreachable attestation
the _completion_precheck docstring does not document the disposition branch None path, causing callers to incorrectly infer that unsigned closures are always forced or gated-off
